item.title: Watch the Dramatic Rescue of a Buried Skier at Palisades Tahoe
item.description: A viral video was recently posted from Palisades Tahoe showing the dramatic rescue of a skier buried deep in fresh powder from the recent storms.

item.title: Big Wave Surfer Pete Shaw Breaks Down His Heaviest Moments at Nazaré and Mullaghmore
item.description: Pete Shaw's new YouTube series breaks down some of his heaviest moments in big waves. He highlights two memorable waves at Nazare and Mullaghmore.

item.title: Man Knocked Off Foil by Hammerhead Shark in Wild Encounter
item.description: Adam Baber was capturing footage of a recent foiling session for his Instagram page when he had the once in a lifetime encounter with a hammerhead shark.

item.title: Alex Honnold Discusses Pooping While Dangling Thousands of Feet in the Air
item.description: When you gotta go, you gotta go. When Alex Honnold has to go, though, he has found himself in some very odd places. Like dangling off a cliff.

item.title: Republican Lawmaker Proposes Bill That Would Strip Eileen Gu of Sponsor Income; Are Surfers Next?
item.description: A Republican lawmaker has proposed a bill that would strip Eileen Gu of her income from competing for China. Would surfers be next on the chopping block?

item.title: Surfers Catch Giant Barramundi With Bare Hands While On a Wave
item.description: The two friends brought the fish in on a wave moments later intending to cook it, but they eventually decided against that given how large the creature was.

item.title: Matt Meola Stars in ‘One of a Kind,’ a Look Into a Life Well Lived
item.description: Matt Meola is one of the most interesting surfers around, but he isn't a guy that's dropping clips to YouTube every 10 seconds. Still, he's living life well.

item.title: 6 Things You Can’t Do Because Surf Culture Thinks They’re Kooky
item.description: Surfers are a touchy bunch, and the slightest misstep can get you the worst label surf culture has: kook. Here's how to avoid it.

item.title: German Leon Glatzer Wants You to Look at Surfing Differently
item.description: Leon Glatzer was raised by German parents in Costa Rica and has proven himself on the world stage. Now he wants people to see his surfing in a different light.

item.title: Surfer Rescued From Brink of Death Explains Why It Pays to Be Friendly In the Lineup
item.description: A Southern California surfer showed how being kind to fellow surfers in the lineup can pay dividends after he suffered a spinal cord injury in Oceanside.
